purpose: User-requested adoption of native GitHub Actions parallel steps in the compatibility pin refresh workflow.
failure_detail: The plugin selection check found that current upstream registry/statistics hashes and download counts differ from the frozen snapshot. Its script and fixture were not changed by the parallel-step update; the failure is retained for review rather than silently refreshing the recorded selection.
conclusion: The workflow ran all four checks concurrently and waited for all results. Three checks passed; the job failed only on the stale upstream selection snapshot.
